description: This file defines the 'Subjects' interface in Java, representing a collection of Subject objects within a policy framework. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, setting, removing, and serializing Subjects, along with associated metadata. It is part of a policy model for the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically in the 'model.policies' package.

classes.name: Subjects
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of Subject objects within a policy, providing methods for creation, access, modification, removal, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Subjects instance from an iterable of Subject objects or from a single Subject and varargs of Subjects.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions that support Subjects, specifically indicating support for version V_2.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves a Subject by issuer+ID, issuer+subject, or SubjectId, returning an Optional.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets or replaces a Subject in the collection, returning a new Subjects instance.

methods.name: removeSubject
methods.description: Removes a Subject identified by issuer+ID, issuer+subject, or SubjectId, returning a new Subjects instance.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of Subjects contained.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the collection contains no Subjects.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a sequential Stream of the subjects for functional operations.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Subjects to a JsonObject, including only non-hidden fields, with support for schema versioning and field selection.
